Eligibility Category: Specific Learning Disability (SLD) - Reading

The primary educational need is Reading.
This IEP addresses Reading for Daniel Okafor.
Daniel has a persistent reading concern.
Classroom performance indicates difficulty reading connected grade-level text with expected fluency.
Daniel has difficulty reading connected grade-level text with expected fluency.
This difficulty affects Daniel's ability to access grade-level reading activities independently.
